_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Production Inspection Equipment Test Systems Engineering Design Data
summary: Provides engineering design data pertinent to the design of components, equipment, or software, used for analytical evaluation of test system performance during subsequent testing.
description_purpose: Engineering design data provides information pertinent to the design of components, equipment or software and necessary for the understanding of these items during subsequent test. Data is used for analytical evaluation of the inherent ability of the test systems to attain the required performance.
application_interrelationship: This data item description contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement for this data included in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The design data shall be in contractor format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Production Inspection Equipment Test Systems Engineering Design Data shall contain the following sections:

children.title: Design Data.
children.content: Design data shall include test programs and test program translations when the test system employs automatic test equipment.

children.title: Software Data.
children.content: Software data shall include an explanation of all special purpose extensions for the program language and description of the program logic. The software documentation shall be suitable for analytical evaluation of the inherent ability of the programming to perform all test and calibration requirements with respect to specifications in accordance with contract requirements.

children.title: Equipment Programming Instruction (EPI).
children.content: The EPI shall contain the procedures necessary to configure and link the program into an operating system. The EPI shall consist of functional descriptions of source language listings with sufficient commentary for understanding each subroutine (drivers), calculations, measurement point and error condition.
